# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** school teacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss Stacy  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>; Miss  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy has lovely fair curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears sleeve puffs that are larger than anyone else's in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a bright, sympathetic young woman with the happy gift of winning and holding the affections of her pupils, bringing out their best both mentally and morally. She maintains perfect order in her schoolroom without ever resorting to corporal punishment.

_Sources: [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v2 c4 P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy was hired by the school trustees as Avonlea's first female teacher. Upon taking charge of Avonlea school, she introduced innovative methods such as morning and evening physical culture exercises, biweekly Friday recitation afternoons, and field days dedicated to studying flowers, ferns, and birds. She formed the Queen's class to prepare ambitious pupils for the Entrance examinations to Queen's Academy, advising students like Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe on their academic tracks. During her tenure, she gently corrected student missteps—such as Anne reading novels in class—and held mock practice exams in June. Her term in Avonlea concluded at the end of the school year, marked by a touching farewell to her students. She later revisited Avonlea, where she was invited to attend a dinner held by Anne Shirley in honor of visiting author Mrs. Morgan.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c30 P9](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0009), [v1 c30 P11](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0011), [v1 c30 P28](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0028), [v1 c31 P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028), [v1 c32 P0](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0000), [v1 c34 P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v2 c16 P22](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0022), [v2 c17 P55](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0055)_

## Quotes

> “But you’ve done good work this past year,” Miss Stacy told them on the last evening, “and you deserve a good, jolly vacation. Have the best time you can in the out-of-door world and lay in a good stock of health and vitality and ambition to carry you through next year. It will be the tug of war, you know—the last year before the Entrance.”  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
